title: Reefer Cargo Services: remote monitoring, alarm response standard and the monitoring fee
content:
## Scope

This quick reference of **Reefer Cargo Services** states which tiers are remotely monitored by the line, the service standard for acting on a remote alarm, and how the remote monitoring fee is charged.

## Rule

1. On tiers where remote monitoring is included, the unit is remotely monitored by the line.
2. Remote monitoring is charged **once, at delivery**, as the tier's daily remote monitoring fee multiplied by the number of calendar days from departure to delivery.
3. On a tier where remote monitoring is not included, no remote monitoring fee is charged.
4. The alarm response standard is the tier's service standard for acting on a remote alarm; it is 0 where the unit is not monitored.

## Quick reference by tier

| Tier | Remotely monitored by the line | Alarm response standard | Remote monitoring fee per calendar day at sea |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | No | 0 (not monitored) | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | Yes | 4 hours | 12.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | Yes | 2 hours | 12.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Yes | 2 hours | 15.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | Yes | 1 hour | 25.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | Yes | 2 hours | 15.00 USD |

## Calculation illustration (hypothetical day count)

> Assume a voyage for which the calendar days from departure to delivery come to 20 days.
> - AHL Reefer Pharma GDP: 20 days multiplied by 25.00 USD gives a remote monitoring fee of 500.00 USD, charged once when the reefer is delivered.
> - AHL Reefer Monitored: 20 days multiplied by 12.00 USD gives 240.00 USD.
> - AHL Reefer Standard: no remote monitoring fee, because the tier is not remotely monitored.

The day count itself is taken from the departure and delivery of the service; the illustration above simply assumes a count to show the multiplication.

## Basis Q&A

**When does the remote monitoring fee appear on the service?** At delivery, as a single charge for the whole period from departure to delivery.

**Is the remote monitoring fee part of the plug-in fee at the terminals?** No. It is a separate charge made once at delivery on monitored tiers.

**How quickly should the line act on a remote alarm for a Pharma GDP container?** The tier's service standard is 1 hour.
